clips.title: The story
paras: Shelene Rhobart is a Forsaken leatherworking trainer stationed along the road in Tirisfal Glades. Operating out of a Deathguard waystation, she supplies cured hides and leathercraft training to support the Forsaken's military and logistical efforts across the blighted lands.

Shelene Rhobart plies her trade at a Deathguard waystation, an outpost situated southeast of Brill along the main road toward the ruins of Lordaeron. Even in undeath, practical crafts remain essential for survival and war. Shelene works with animal pelts collected from the prowling beasts of Tirisfal, refining tough hides into armor, straps, and field gear to supply local Forsaken patrols contending with both the Scourge and Scarlet crusaders.
